references.text: The Lord commands the people to go in and take possession of the land he swore to give to their fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The Lord told Moses to stand up and go down from the mountain, a similar command to lead the people.
The Lord commands Moses to lead the people to the place he has spoken about.
The Lord commands Moses to go up with the people to the land he swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The departure of the Israelites from the Wilderness of Sinai, beginning the journey toward the Promised Land.
God's promise to Abraham to give his descendants the land, the original oath referred to here.
God confirms the oath to Isaac to give his descendants all these lands.
God confirms the promise to Jacob regarding the land that was given to Abraham and Isaac.
Moses hands over leadership to Joshua to lead the people into the land the Lord swore to give their fathers.
